messages.subject: Re: Rapache Architecture
parts:
On Thu, Jun 14, 2012 at 5:33 PM, RoKha <romesh....@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi,
>
> I am new to R and R-Apache and trying to understand it more to understand
> whether will it be right to invest time in it. I can say that I understand
> many things in there, but wanted to know a few more.
> My project is going to compute large data sets, which will have sudden burst
> of requests. For this reason, I am looking for an statistical computing
> architecture which can be integrated with memcached or equivalent. My
> concern is: can R-Apache be integrated with something like memcached,
> wrapping around MySQL data. This way, the similar data requests can be
> cached and response time can be reduced. An alternative can be some R
> package which caches the MySQL data in the system environment. Any help
> about this would be great.

I have started an rmemcache client for R:

https://github.com/jeffreyhorner/rmemcache

I've had success with it, but it's still experimental.

Jeff
